nodes.label: Row-level security policies
nodes.rationale: A user sees a flock's rows only if they are an active member; private profile fields are never selectable

nodes.label: dev-open-access.sql demo file
nodes.rationale: Demo only: opens every table to the anon key; never apply to a project with real users

nodes.label: Supabase schema and migrations
nodes.rationale: Schema, demo data and RLS live in supabase/ so anyone can rebuild the database

nodes.label: Server-only secrets
nodes.rationale: Anthropic, Vexcel, service-role and CoStar zip keys are server or script only; never NEXT_PUBLIC

nodes.label: User-scoped Supabase client in agent tools
nodes.norm_label: user-scoped supabase client in agent tools
nodes.rationale: Built from the caller's access token so RLS applies; service-role key is never used inside tools

nodes.label: listings table (one row per floor plan)
nodes.norm_label: listings table (one row per floor plan)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the seeded Brooklyn listings table; keeps the id-based joins that swipes, stash and tours use

nodes.label: Brooklyn-to-LA cutover (ticket T4)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately not a migration: deletes swipes, tours, messages and Brooklyn listings; run on a test database first

nodes.label: One card per community
nodes.rationale: Deck and map show one building per card with the best-fitting floor plan; votes attach to the floor plan because that is what the flock rents

nodes.label: compat() roommate compatibility
nodes.rationale: Deterministic: compares structured tags in code; LLM only extracts tags from free text

nodes.label: flockScore (lib/compare.ts)
nodes.rationale: Computed on read, never stored, so it cannot go stale when votes or membership change

nodes.label: join_flock database function
nodes.rationale: One transaction with a row lock so two people cannot both take the last spot

nodes.label: Flock Deep Agent (deepagents)
nodes.rationale: All agentic behavior runs on one LangChain Deep Agent; model calls and secrets stay on the server

nodes.label: Ducktect best option
nodes.rationale: Gives the search bar an intent mode that surfaces the agent and Vexcel in the main flow; name spelling still to be confirmed

nodes.label: Agent proposals tables
nodes.rationale: A proposed group becomes a flock only when every invitee accepts

nodes.label: Apartments.com image enrichment
nodes.rationale: Offline resumable batch job, never request-time; stop on bot challenges; kit photo is the fallback; hackathon use only

nodes.label: Vexcel aerial evidence
nodes.rationale: Checks visual wishes (pool, tree cover, park) from aerial imagery; never infers subjective properties like quiet or safe

nodes.label: Open-flock consent model
nodes.rationale: Owner rules are standing consent from members; agent-proposed groups need explicit accept from everyone. Needs team sign-off

nodes.label: Find your people, then find your place
nodes.norm_label: find your people, then find your place
nodes.rationale: Core product goal: make it easy to find an apartment that works for everyone in a flock

nodes.label: Read-only Ducktect agent
nodes.rationale: Only searcher and aerial subagents, no write tools: least privilege, no surprise changes to flock data

nodes.label: Combined budget feasibility rule
nodes.rationale: budget_max is each person's maximum rent share; a listing is feasible if the active members combined budget covers its rent

nodes.label: Five design principles
nodes.rationale: Real data first; the group decides; scores come from code not the model; consent before sharing; say what we do not know

nodes.label: Profile privacy rules
nodes.rationale: A requester never sees budgets, habits or dealbreakers before the person accepts; matching outputs coarse reasons only

nodes.label: Thumbs-down removal threshold
nodes.rationale: Item is contested on any thumbs-down; leaves the active shortlist when thumbs-down reaches half the active members rounded up; kept in history

nodes.label: Thumbs up/down voting
nodes.rationale: Same icons as the For You deck; a thumbs-down can carry a reason chip that feeds the agent; comments are separate

nodes.label: CoStar data kit
nodes.rationale: Primary listing source; one row per community and floor plan; field names still marked verify

nodes.label: CoStar ingest run (ticket T3)
nodes.rationale: Dry run by default; writes need --confirm and refuse the live project unless --allow-live; re-runs are safe
